prompt: Why were only three cartons received?

options.text: The order was intentionally divided into two shipments
options.zh: 訂單刻意分成兩批出貨
options.whyZh: 出貨通知說先寄六十個三箱，剩餘六十個另寄。

options.text: The laboratory rejected delivery at reception
options.zh: 實驗室在接待處拒收貨物
options.whyZh: 接待處已正常收貨，沒有拒收資訊。

options.text: Half the cartons were damaged and returned
options.whyZh: 內部訊息說無外觀損傷，也沒有退貨。

options.text: The purchase order requested only sixty sensors
options.whyZh: 採購單總量是一百二十個。

explanationZh: 出貨通知說先寄六十個三箱，剩餘六十個另寄。
evidence: We shipped 60 sensors today in three cartons. The remaining 60 will leave our warehouse on September 8.

vocabulary.note: 一筆訂單拆成不同批次運送。
依既定規則管理存放與領用的區域。
